name: freesasa
argv: Analyze the PC third-party library checked out at repos/freesasa. Follow the method and JSON output contract in .claude/agents/pc-lib-analyzer.md and the skills it references. The source is already cloned — do NOT clone again. Run the deterministic code-metrics script with `--out runs/freesasa/2026-06-22T02-54-50-878Z/metrics.json`, reason through every dimension (function summary, license, dependencies, native/platform API), and write the final report to runs/freesasa/2026-06-22T02-54-50-878Z/report.json. Conform to references/report_schema.json. 语言要求：function_summary 里所有自然语言字段（summary、每个 category 的 name 与 description、domain、target_users）以及 library.one_liner 必须用简体中文书写；SPDX 许可证标识、编程语言名、依赖包名等专有名词保持原文。IMPORTANT: write the report, metrics, and ALL intermediate/scratch files inside the project (under the run directory) — never use /tmp or any path outside the project, because the headless runner auto-rejects external directories and the run will abort. Finish with a short digest. codegraph is installed and enabled: first build a structural index with `codegraph index repos/freesasa`, then prefer `codegraph context/query/callers -p repos/freesasa -j` for the function-summary and native/platform-API dimensions (fall back to grep/Read if any codegraph call fails).  Do NOT spawn sub-agents or use the `task` tool; do all work yourself in this single session.
